title: Audio Spectrum
description: A live spectrum analyzer that dances to whatever is playing.

title: Aurora
description: Flowing curtains of northern light rippling across a dark sky.

title: Bass Pulse
description: Your whole setup thumps and flashes with the bass and every beat.

title: Beat Ripples
description: Every beat launches a colorful shockwave ring from the center.

title: Beat Sequencer
description: A sixteen-step drum-machine chase that lands one glowing pad on every beat.

title: Bioluminescent Tide
description: Night waves roll across a dark sea, waking glowing plankton that flare blue-green in their wake and slowly fade.

title: Block Drop
description: Bright falling blocks lock into place on their own, and every finished line flashes white before it vanishes.

title: Breathing
description: A slow, soothing glow that fades in and out like a sleeping breath.

title: Breathing Coach
description: A guiding orb of light that swells as you breathe in, rests while you hold, and softens away as you breathe out.

title: Candlelight
description: A cluster of candles, each flickering on its own breath of air, pooling soft amber light around them.

title: Cherry Blossom Wind
description: Soft pink petals tumble and swirl on spring gusts across a gentle pastel sky.

title: Chomp Chase
description: A hungry snap-box chomper gobbles dots down a glowing corridor with a gang of blob ghosts on its tail, until a power pellet turns the tables.

title: Color Cycle
description: Your whole setup glides smoothly through every hue.

title: Comet Passage
description: Now and then a comet glides silently across a quiet, twinkling sky, trailing a long luminous ion tail and a soft veil of dust.

title: Daylight Sync
description: Your lights follow the real sky: amber sunrise, clear bright daylight, golden hour and a deep blue night, blended through the day.

title: Desert Mirage
description: Heat haze ripples over sunset dunes while a phantom lake of sky shimmers on the sand.

title: Digital Rain
description: Cascading columns of code falling down your setup with glowing trails.

title: Disco Floor
description: A glowing seventies dance floor whose tiles flip colour in checkers, waves and scatters to the beat.

title: Emergency Lights
description: A rooftop light bar in red and blue that double-flashes, wig-wags and spins its rotating beacons.

title: Event Horizon
description: A black hole holds court at the centre of your setup, its glowing accretion disk swirling around a perfect shadow and bent into a blazing ring of light.

title: Fire
description: Roaring flames licking upward from the bottom of your setup.

title: Firefly Sync
description: Fireflies drift over a dusk meadow, blinking out of step until they fall into rhythm and flash together, then scatter and begin again.

title: Fireworks Night
description: Rockets streak up from the rooftops and bloom into drifting showers of colour, with a grand finale now and then.

title: Focus Timer
description: A Pomodoro timer in light: calm colour slowly rises through your focus session, then a soft pulse invites a break.

title: Forest Canopy
description: Lying under the trees on a summer afternoon: golden sun spots slip and shimmer through swaying, backlit leaves.

title: Galaxy Spin
description: A spiral galaxy wheels slowly around its glowing heart, thousands of stars strung along sweeping arms that fade from cyan to violet.

title: Glacier Light
description: Deep inside a blue glacier: slow refracted light bands drift through ancient ice, catching faint glints along hairline cracks.

title: Gradient Flow
description: A three-color gradient that scrolls endlessly at any angle.

title: Hex Pulse
description: A honeycomb of neon tiles flares and fades as shockwaves ripple outward from random sparks.

title: Hyperspace Jump
description: Cruise through a quiet starfield until the stars stretch into blazing streaks, a white flash hurls you across the galaxy, and calm returns under a new sky.

title: Ink Bloom
description: Drops of coloured ink bloom open and curl into one another like ink falling through still water.

title: Kaleidoscope
description: Mirrored wedges of molten colour turn and bloom around a glowing heart, like a hand-spun kaleidoscope.

title: Laser Show
description: Club lasers fan and scissor through drifting haze, flaring wider on the bass and splaying on the highs.

title: Lava Fissures
description: A dark cooling lava crust split by glowing cracks that slowly shift, with molten surges flaring up through the seams.

title: Lava Lamp
description: Soft glowing blobs that drift, merge and split like a retro lava lamp.

title: Life Colony
description: Conway's Game of Life as a neon colony: cells glow, age through colour and leave fading ghost trails.

title: Light Cycles
description: Glowing riders race across a dark grid, carving solid walls of light and swerving to survive until one crashes in a burst.

title: Liquid Chrome
description: A slow, mirror-bright pool of liquid metal rolls and ripples, catching studio light on every swell.

title: Lissajous Glow
description: A thick neon harmonograph pen sweeps out slowly morphing Lissajous figures, trailing light behind it.

title: Living Cells
description: Soft pastel cells drift, divide and merge beneath a glowing web of membranes.

title: Low Health Warning
description: A heart monitor races across the screen while the edges throb blood red with every beat, like your character is one hit from game over.

title: Maze Runner
description: A neon maze carves itself out block by block, then a blazing path races from start to finish before it all dissolves.

title: Meteor Shower
description: Shooting stars streak across your setup trailing long glowing tails.

title: Moire Drift
description: Overlapping line and ring gratings slide past each other, conjuring broad rivers of interference light.

title: Nebula Drift
description: Luminous clouds of interstellar gas fold slowly into one another while a few bright stars shine through the haze.

title: Orbital Dance
description: Glowing worlds loop and slingshot around a pair of twin suns, painting the dark with fading ribbons of neon light.

title: Pixel Invaders
description: A blocky alien fleet marches and drops while a lone cannon blasts it apart in bursts of neon light.

title: Plasma
description: Classic demoscene plasma: liquid, ever-shifting blobs of color.

title: Pong Rally
description: Two tireless paddles trade a glowing ball that streaks faster with every hit until someone finally misses.

title: Pool Caustics
description: A living net of sunlight dances across the floor of a clear swimming pool as ripples bend the light.

title: Prism Split
description: A white beam strikes a slowly turning glass prism and fans out into a sweeping rainbow.

title: Pulsar Beacon
description: A spinning neutron star sweeps twin searchlight beams through cosmic dust, flashing a ripple of light every time a beam swings past.

title: Rainbow Wave
description: Smooth rainbow bands sweeping across your setup in any direction.

title: Rainy Window
description: Raindrops bead and slide down a fogged window while the city glows behind it in soft, blurred lights.

title: Ringed Planet
description: A pastel gas giant turns slowly inside its tilted rings, banded clouds drifting past a soft terminator while little moons glide around it.

title: Ripples
description: Glowing rings spread outward from random points like raindrops on a pond.

title: Screen Ambience
description: Extends your screen onto your lights by mirroring its colors in real time.

title: Snake Autopilot
description: A glowing snake steers itself across the grid, hunting food and growing longer until it finally gets boxed in.

title: Snowfall Evening
description: Soft snow drifts down through a deep blue winter dusk, lit from below by the warm glow of a distant town.

title: Solar Surface
description: Hover just above a seething star: boiling granules churn across its face while looping flares of plasma arc off the glowing limb.

title: Solid Color
description: One steady color across your entire setup.

title: Spectrum Tunnel
description: Fly down a winding tunnel built from rings of sound, each one stamped with the music at the moment it was born.

title: Spiral Vortex
description: A hypnotic multi-armed spiral spinning around the center of your setup.

title: Supernova Cycle
description: A star swells into a burning giant, collapses in on itself and detonates in a blinding shockwave of glowing debris, before a new star kindles from the ashes.

title: Synthwave Horizon
description: An endless neon grid rolls toward you beneath a striped retro sun and a glowing dusk sky.

title: Thunderstorm
description: Heavy clouds roll overhead through sheets of rain until a forked bolt tears down and floods the whole setup with light.

title: Turing Patterns
description: A living reaction–diffusion chemistry grows coral, spots and labyrinths that slowly spread and renew themselves.

title: Twinkle Stars
description: Soft points of light that fade in and out like a starry night.

title: VHS Glitch
description: A worn-out tape signal: colour bars tear sideways, channels split apart and bursts of static roll through the picture.

title: Vintage String Lights
description: Swags of big old-fashioned glass bulbs glowing against the night, gently twinkling like a porch at the holidays.
